# Central Confederation of Africa
The [bold]Central Confederation of Africa[/bold] (CCA) is a union of the nations of Africa, founded in the 2050s. For much of its history it was the junior partner of the larger powers, and its economy slumped through the long rivalries of the 22nd century.
## The Nyame Sector - In the late 2170s the CCA colonized the [bold]Nyame Sector[/bold], out beyond the Far Reach. - The sector quickly grew into an economic powerhouse, and with it the CCA's fortunes turned. - By the mid 2180s the [bold]CCA dollar[/bold] has risen so far in value that it rivals the Weyland-Yutani colony dollar.
## On the Frontier The CCA's newfound wealth gives it real weight among the powers competing for the colonies, with the CCA funding many new establishments in the Neroid Sector.
